m1.typescript: m1 a document with every value present and quoted comes back valid on the first attempt

e1.typescript: e1 a value the document does not give is null and needs no quote while an invented value fails as ungrounded

e2.typescript: e2 a retry carries the original document the failed record and only the errors a second look can fix

e3.typescript: e3 a required value that the model reports as absent is not retried and goes to review

e4.typescript: e4 retries stop after the limit and the document is marked failed

e5.typescript: e5 a total that differs from the line items is a semantic error and a flagged conflict goes to review without a retry

e6.typescript: e6 currency takes unclear and other with a detail and rejects anything else as a syntax error

e7.typescript: e7 chunk results merge by keeping the first value and recording a conflict when two chunks disagree

e8.typescript: e8 accuracy counts every document and not only the validated ones

e9.typescript: e9 the request forces a tool where the model allows it and falls back to auto with a reply check where it does not

wrong-grounding-skipped.defect: accepts a quote that does not appear in the document

wrong-null-needs-quote.defect: demands a quote for a value that is null

wrong-feedback-all-errors.defect: sends every error back, including the ones a second look cannot fix

wrong-feedback-no-previous.defect: leaves the failed record out of the retry

wrong-retry-absent.defect: retries a value that the model reported as absent

wrong-absent-failed.defect: marks a document with only absent values as failed instead of sending it to review

wrong-extra-retry.defect: makes one retry more than the limit

wrong-sum-unchecked.defect: never compares the line items with the calculated total

wrong-conflict-error.defect: treats a conflict the model flagged as a semantic error

wrong-conflict-valid.defect: marks a document with a flagged conflict as valid

wrong-unclear-needs-quote.defect: demands a quote for a currency that is unclear

wrong-other-no-detail.defect: accepts the currency other without a detail

wrong-merge-last-wins.defect: lets a later chunk replace an earlier value

wrong-merge-no-conflict.defect: never records a conflict between chunks

wrong-accuracy-validated-only.defect: divides by the validated documents and calls it accuracy

wrong-accuracy-missing-skipped.defect: leaves the documents without a result out of the count

wrong-force-always.defect: forces a tool on models that reject a forced choice

wrong-any-for-single.defect: uses any where one named tool is enough

wrong-no-verify.defect: does not ask for a reply check on the fallback
